stem: Coal is an example of –
expl: Sedimentary rocks are formed by the deposition of sediment usually in the form of layers. Sedimentary rocks are also known as layered rocks. Most fossils and mineral oil are found in these rocks. Sedimentary rocks cover 75% of the Earth's surface. Minerals like Coal, Slate, Limestone, Salt, Petroleum, Marble, etc. are examples of sedimentary Rock. Depending on the amount of carbon and hardness, coal is Segregated in to four categories – (i) Anthracite : It is the best kind of coal. It has about 90-95% carbon content. (ii) Bituminous : It is the second most important type of coal and is the most abundant coal. It has a carbon content between 70-90%. (iii) Lignite: It is often referred to brown coal. It has a carbon content between 45-50%. It is mostly used in thermal power stations. (iv) Peat : It is the lowest rank of coal having a carbon content of less than 40%.

stem:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Sumed pipeline is a strategic route for Persian Gulf oil and natural gas shipments to Europe.
Statement-II: Sumed pipeline connects the Red Sea with the Mediterranean Sea.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?

options.label: a
options.text: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I

options.label: b
options.text: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I

options.label: c
options.text: Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect

options.label: d
options.text: Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct

expl: The Sumed pipeline (also known as the Suez-Mediterranean pipeline) is an oil pipeline in Egypt, running from the Ain Sokhna terminal in the Gulf of Suez, the northernmost terminus of the Red Sea, to offshore Sidi Kerir port, Alexandria in the Mediterranean Sea. It provides an alternative to the Suez Canal for transporting oil from the Persian Gulf region to the Mediterranean. The Suez Canal and the Sumed pipeline are strategic routes for Persian Gulf crude oil, petroleum products, and liquefied natural gas (LNG) shipments to Europe and North America. The Suez Canal and Sumed pipeline are both located in Egypt and connect the Red Sea with the Mediterranean Sea. Hence, both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, and Statement-II explains Statement-I. So, option (a) is the correct answer. However, it is to be noted that Sumed pipeline is an oil pipeline which transports crude oil only (not natural gas). So, in literal terms, Statement-I could be incorrect and in that case option (d) will be the correct answer.

stem:
Recently, there has been a concern over the short supply of a group of elements called ‘rare earth metals’. Why?
1. China, which is the largest producer of these elements, has imposed some restrictions on their export.
2. Other than China, Australia ,Canada and Chile, these elements are not found in any country.
3. Rare earth metals are essential for the manufacture of various kinds of electronic items and there is a growing demand for these elements.
Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
expl: Rare earth metals are a group of 17 chemical elements found in the earth's crust that are vital to many modern technologies including consumer electronics, computers, networks, communications, clean energy, etc. All of the world's heavy rare earth comes from Chinese rare earth sources. In 2010, China produced over 95% of the world's rare earth metals supply (According to USGS, Mineral Commodity Summaries, 2026 (data 2025) China produced about 70% rare earths). China has announced regulations on exports and a crackdown on smuggling. Since these metals were easily available from China and their production causes serious trouble to environment. Therefore, most of the countries stopped their production. According to Mineral Commodity Summaries, 2025 India have 6900000 thousands tonnes reserves of rare earth metals. Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.
